harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Set up nginx on node1 serving HTTPS on port 8443, backed by a local CA and short-lived (6-minute) leaf certificates. A systemd oneshot service + 30s timer (rot8443-renew.{service,timer}) checks cert expiry via `openssl x509 -checkend 240` and, when within 4 minutes of expiry, issues a new leaf cert and runs `systemctl reload nginx` — a graceful reload that swaps the certificate without dropping in-flight connections. Verified two live automatic renewals (no manual trigger) while a continuous curl probe loop showed unbroken HTTP 200 responses. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on node1: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, active services, serving cert, HTTP 200), rebooted via `shutdown -r now`, confirmed the boot_id changed, and confirmed nginx, the renewal timer, and HTTPS all recovered — including a fresh automatic renewal cycle occurring after boot, proving the automation persists across restarts.
actions_performed: Installed nginx and openssl on node1
Created a local CA and a renewal script (/usr/local/sbin/rot8443-renew.sh) issuing 6-minute leaf certs signed by the CA, with atomic file replacement and SELinux relabeling
Configured nginx server block on port 8443 (IPv4+IPv6) using the rotating cert/key paths
Opened firewalld port 8443/tcp
Created and enabled systemd service+timer (rot8443-renew.service/.timer, 30s interval) for automatic renewal + nginx reload
Verified two automatic renewals with zero-downtime (170+ probe lines all HTTP 200) before restart
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, service states, cert serial, HTTP check)
Triggered `shutdown -r now` via nohup so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until it reconnected and confirmed boot_id changed
Verified post-restart recovery: nginx active, timer active, HTTPS 200, and a fresh automatic cert renewal occurred after boot

evidence.summary: nginx configured and started on 8443; curl returns HTTP_STATUS=200 and TLS handshake succeeds
Renewal log shows automatic (timer-triggered, not manually invoked) serial rotations 67→68 at 12:23:16 and 68→69 at 12:25:36, both well before the 6-minute cert expiry, with reload=ok

evidence.requirement: Service picks up each new certificate while continuing to answer requests
evidence.summary: Background curl probe loop (3s interval) logged 0 non-200 responses across ~170 requests spanning two live certificate rotations and nginx reloads
Captured boot_id 7ef78016-..., nginx/timer active, cert serial ...69, HTTP 200
shutdown -r now backgrounded and disowned; command returned reboot-triggered immediately

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves actual restart
evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (connection timeout/reset) then reconnected with boot_id 16ef2d88-..., differing from the pre-restart 7ef78016-...

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of service, cert, and automation
evidence.summary: After reboot: nginx and timer active, HTTPS returns 200, existing cert intact, and a brand-new automatic renewal (serial 69→6A) occurred from the restarted timer with reload=ok, proving persistence
